user_intent: Browse the complete schema, contract and API package.
renderer: L0 semantic HTML and inline SVG with optional local selection controls
evidence_boundary: Registry shapes and pairs are source-backed. All APIs, semantic interfaces and proposed behaviors are candidate design. No running proof/check service or theorem correctness claim.

open_decisions.question: Pin the initial Lean toolchain, approved axioms and exact required soundness statement.
open_decisions.default_direction: Record reproducible checked proof dependencies and retain parser, hashing and compiled-runtime assumptions explicitly.

open_decisions.question: Select the L0 graph invariant and normative qualifier/reference semantics.
open_decisions.default_direction: Use the three-kind slice and smallest meaningful invariant from the analysis; record a reviewed contract in P01.

open_decisions.question: Select the companion/successor carrier policy for full registry coverage.
open_decisions.default_direction: Keep frozen Typed Relation/v2 bytes and propose a separate explicit carrier profile.

open_decisions.question: Select the first supported extension profiles and exact compatibility promises.
open_decisions.default_direction: Instance additions under fixed theory first; add definitional new-kind profiles only with evidence.

open_decisions.question: Select protected conclusions and legitimate exact-scope root justification.
open_decisions.default_direction: Constrain targetVersion, effect, scope and epoch; preserve independently justified existing facts.

open_decisions.question: Select toolchain, proof-submission isolation, accepted axioms and evidence thresholds.
open_decisions.default_direction: Pin dependencies and replay isolated submissions with exact statement and axiom audits.
